CONTROL FAILED: the row_q collection is EMPTY.  Either this netlist
predates L2, or every row_q bit was optimised away, or row_q was
PACKED INTO AN INFERRED MEMORY (see the memory-node list above --
that is what happened to L1's dec_q), or the glob is wrong.  NO L-8
RESULT IS EMITTED -- an empty collection returns no path, and 'no
path' would read as 'the class does not bind'.
